name: Gold Spiral Islamic Calligraphy
short_desc: Elevate your luxury home decor with this breathtaking circular Islamic wall art featuring Ayatul Kursi and prominent "Allah" calligraphy. Handcrafted with rich burgundy, shimmering gold, and deep olive accents, this masterpiece brings spiritual elegance and grandeur to formal living rooms, entryways, and executive spaces.
seo_title: : Premium 24x24 Hand-Painted Acrylic Canvas Art – Ayatul Kursi & "Allah" Modern Islamic Wall Decor with Varnish Finish
description:
Transform your space with this breathtaking, high-end Islamic calligraphy masterpiece designed to bring divine elegance, spiritual peace, and artistic luxury into your home. This exquisite artwork features a mesmerizing circular composition centering on the revered Ayatul Kursi with the sacred name "Allah" sweeping gracefully across the left side in bold, sweeping white script.

Crafted with high-grade acrylic paints, the piece showcases a rich texture and vibrant palette. The background features a dramatic, blended mixture of dark green and deep red, creating a stunning contrast behind the central golden spiral motif. Intricate black and gold circular bands house the fine Arabic script, while the prominent white calligraphy of "Allah" commands immediate attention, establishing a harmonious balance between traditional calligraphy and contemporary abstract art.

To ensure long-lasting quality and durability, the artwork is treated with a protective gloss varnish seal. This varnish coat not only shields the acrylic layers from dust, moisture, and UV color fading, but it also accentuates the richness of the colors, giving the art an exquisite, subtle shine under ambient lighting.

Set within a sleek frame, this hand-painted acrylic artwork serves as an ideal focal point for formal living rooms, entryways, prayer areas, or executive offices. Whether styled over dark wood paneling, neutral plaster walls, or modern feature walls, it delivers a timeless statement of faith, sophistication, and fine artistry.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish finish for durability and color preservation

Theme & Script: Ayatul Kursi with prominent "Allah" calligraphic focus

Color Palette: Dark green and red background mix, prominent white script, accented with gold and black details

Style: Modern Islamic Abstract / Traditional Calligraphy Fusion

Ideal Placement: Living room feature wall, foyer, dining area, or home office
